mandatory_framing.rule: A GT-dependent ceiling is not reachable-gain evidence. Every emitted metric record must carry information_label=GT-DEPENDENT or information_label=NON-GT-IDENTIFIABLE.

scope.repair_realization: direct_repair only; late equivalents remain diagnostic persistence evidence

n0.compile_rule: For each frozen event, add exactly direct_repair.required_edges, replace the one parent source and both child targets, and require exact direct_repair.owned_incident_conflicts. Compile each action alone and each per-video batch through frozen N1.
n0.aggregation: official scorer summary per family and pooled CV57

tier_a.name: CURRENT_POOL_CURRENT_FEATURES
tier_a.rule: All exact required edges are either already selected or present in the frozen current candidate-probability map; the exact two oracle children equal the deterministic top-two current-probability targets of the parent; the second target probability is strictly greater than the frozen parent no-link probability; both children have observable selected outgoing continuation; and no decision-boundary tie exists.
tier_a.interpretation: The exact frozen bundle agrees with a fully label-free rule using only the current pool, current probabilities, current graph, and current node times.

tier_b.name: STRONGER_REPRESENTATION_REQUIRED
tier_b.rule: Tier a fails, but all exact parent/child nodes exist in the deployment graph, the two children are distinct, and both required edges point forward in time. A stronger division-aware representation or candidate expansion could in principle distinguish the event; this audit does not claim that such a realizer exists.

tier_c.name: GT_IDENTITY_ONLY
tier_c.rule: Neither tier a nor tier b: an exact required endpoint is absent at deployment, daughters collapse to one node, or the exact bundle violates observable forward-time feasibility. The banked evidence then supplies only GT identity and no deployment-time target.
tier_c.interpretation: GT identity is essential under the banked deployment graph.

n1.assignment: exactly one tier per event; first matching tier in a,b,c order
n1.score_share: Report exact tier-only subset deltas and a three-tier Shapley allocation of the pooled N0 combined-score delta. Shapley shares sum exactly to the N0 ceiling.

n2.compile_and_score: exactly the same N1 action and official scorer path as N0
n2.caveat: The subset is an information-requirement diagnostic, not a trained selector or deployment result.

n3.curve: For each N2 subset with T exact true forks, enumerate hypothetical FP counts and precision=T/(T+FP). Hold the measured true-bundle edge term fixed and vary only division Jaccard T/(42+FP).
n3.interpretation: edge-neutral false-fork upper bound; actual false forks may also damage edge Jaccard

n4.barrier: Consume DAG 2 only after a terminal artifact is frozen and hash-pinned.
n4.schema_rule: Add division as a fourth action class using DAG 2's exact schema without changing any frozen threshold.

n5.amendment_proposal_condition: Only if the N2 realizable subset is materially large and DAG 2's frozen requirement surface says its selector precision is achievable; otherwise emit no proposal.
